name: Mayday Trials
source:
Sora has 24 hours to live.

In Mayday Trials, a dark and intense psychological visual novel, you play as Sora as he is forced to undergo five psychological trials. Each room represents a stage of grief. Each trial confronts him with twisted simulations of his past, brutal revelations about his family, and moral dilemmas with no easy answers.

Your Past is a Trap.

Wake up in a cold interrogation room with a countdown in your head. Sora Halbeth, tech prodigy and CEO. As the voice of Mayday mocks and manipulates him, Sora must confront the truth behind his origins and his choices. Was his success ever truly his? Or was it all a carefully designed trap? Under the trials of Mayday, Sora gets closer to the answers.

Face the Five Trials

Denial. Anger. Bargaining. Depression. Acceptance. Each psychological gauntlet forces Sora to confront manipulated memories and impossible choices—while the clock runs out.

Every decision matters. The trials you guide Sora through will lead to one of three highly consequential endings. Accept the truth, or maybe rewrite it? Maybe there's another path entirely. 

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3452240/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
索拉的生命只剩下24小时了。

在《五月天试炼》这部黑暗而激烈的心理视觉小说中，你扮演索拉，被迫接受五次心理试炼。每个房间都代表着悲伤的一个阶段。每一次审判都让他面临着对过去的扭曲模拟、对家庭的残酷揭露，以及没有简单答案的道德困境。

你的过去是一个陷阱。

在寒冷的审讯室中醒来，脑子里闪着倒计时。索拉·哈尔贝斯 (Sora Halbeth)，科技奇才兼首席执行官。当五月天的声音嘲笑并操纵他时，索拉必须面对他的出身和选择背后的真相。他的成功真的是他的吗？还是这一切都是精心设计的陷阱？在五月天的考验下，空越来越接近答案。

面对五次考验

否认。愤怒。讨价还价。沮丧。验收。每一次心理挑战都迫使索拉面对被操纵的记忆和不可能的选择——而时间已经耗尽。

每个决定都很重要。你引导索拉经历的考验将导致三个极其重要的结局之一。接受事实，或者重写它？也许完全有另一条路。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3452240/]Steam[/url]]
